scope: Actual local Engine/Compose and signed API, including idle provider registration. No Job, interpretation, model call or scientific operation.

old_target.fault_owner: tools/compose_reply_loss.sh at source_revision; actual commands complete before stdout is withheld and status 7 returned
old_target.fencing: Original full-ID/grant admission, acknowledged stop and stopped readback, warning delivered, exact-ID removal, then confirmed absence.

startup_recovery.initial_state: API replacement already running; the other six roles created and unstarted. A completed same-ID API start reply is deliberately withheld.
startup_recovery.result: The original command owner starts only nonrunning admitted IDs and confirms all seven ready. The original operation header and late-start restriction remain retained, without a complete marker.
startup_recovery.public_up: Returned success, observed all seven ready without restarting a component, preserved the original header and did not publish complete.
startup_recovery.public_down: Stopped provider and native dependencies before proxies; fenced the pending API replacement ID by removal and absence; stopped the remaining stack. Six unaffected stopped containers retain bounded Docker logs.

final_peer_receipt.hello_scope: Observed Hello requests; accepted initial registration is established by current provider readiness, not by counting every request as an acknowledgement.

limits: Controlled reply loss and old-ID requests issued after confirmed removal; not a claim about a real network partition or daemon crash. Provider-before-dependency failure controls and bounded same-direction retry retention have separate focused contained tests. No scientific accuracy, live external model or external API/GUI claim.
